# Natural Design System

> Warm, quiet, material-first UI for **Natural**, an online store for nature-based goods that are both decorative and functional: a bench split from a fallen log, a cup thrown from river clay.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Figma** | [Natural Design System](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System) |
| **Storybook** | https://chris-terterian.github.io/natural-design-system/ |
| **Code** | https://github.com/chris-terterian/natural-design-system |
| **Standard** | WCAG 2.2 AA (blocking gate) |
| **Governance** | [`GOVERNANCE.md`](GOVERNANCE.md) · [`DECISIONS.md`](DECISIONS.md) · [`CHANGELOG.md`](CHANGELOG.md) · status: Storybook → *Governance / Component status* |

**How to use this file.** It's the single brief for anyone designing or building for Natural, whether a person or Claude Code. The front matter lists every token with its resolved value, alias and CSS variable.

| § | Section | Answers |
|---|---|---|
| 1–2 | Brand, voice | How Natural looks and sounds |
| 3 | Foundations | The raw material: colour, type, space, radius, icons, imagery, motion |
| 4 | Styles | The named styles built from foundations: text, colour roles, effects, layout |
| 5 | Tokens | How tokens are structured and changed |
| 6 | Components | Full spec for every component: anatomy, properties, sizes, states, behaviour |
| 7 | Patterns | How components combine into store pages |
| 8–10 | Accessibility, workflow, roadmap | The non-negotiables and how changes ship (full process in `GOVERNANCE.md`) |

Items marked **Planned** don't exist yet: don't invent them silently. Propose them. Values in this file are resolved from tokens. In code, always use the CSS variable (`--nds-*`), never the raw value.

---

## 1. Brand & principles

Natural sells things made from wood, clay, stone, fibre and other materials that come from the land. Each piece is useful and beautiful, and it carries the marks of how it was made: knots in the grain, ridges from the potter's hand, uneven edges. The interface is the display table, not the product.

1. **Let the material lead.** The UI is calm and low-contrast in structure so photography and material detail carry the page. No gradients, gloss, heavy shadows or decorative illustration competing with the product.
2. **Warm and tactile.** An earth palette (bark, clay, sand) with soft 8px corners and a single typeface. Surfaces feel like paper and linen, not glass.
3. **Honest.** Real materials, real dimensions, real weights, real lead times. If a piece is one of a kind or ships by freight, say so up front. No vague "eco" or "sustainable" claims without specifics.
4. **Made to last.** Like the goods: accessible, consistent and unhurried. Choose the durable pattern over the trendy one.
5. **Every piece is individual.** Handmade and natural items vary. The UI should make variation feel like a feature ("no two are alike"), never a defect.

---

## 2. Voice & content

**Craft-aware, grounded, quietly poetic.** We write like a maker talking about their work: specific about materials, process and time, with the occasional image from the natural world. Plain first, lyrical second.

### Voice rules

| Do | Don't |
|---|---|
| Name the material, the process and the time it took. *"Cut from a single fallen oak and air-dried for two seasons."* | Use empty adjectives. *"Premium, high-quality, luxurious."* |
| Use one natural image, lightly. *"The glaze pools like still water at the base."* | Stack metaphors or go mystical. *"Channel the ancient spirit of the forest."* |
| Celebrate variation. *"Every knot and check in the grain is its own."* | Apologise for it. *"Slight imperfections may occur."* |
| Be specific about care. *"Oil twice a year to keep the wood from drying out."* | Make unprovable claims. *"100% eco-friendly and sustainable."* |
| Write in sentence case, in short sentences. | Use Title Case Everywhere, exclamation marks or ALL CAPS. |

**Clarity beats poetry.** Buttons, forms, errors, prices, shipping and legal text are always plain. The voice lives in product stories, collection intros and empty states, never in an error message.

### Product copy pattern

Every product page answers the same questions in the same order:

1. **Name:** material-led and simple. *Split Log Bench · River Clay Cup · Woven Rush Basket*
2. **One-line story:** where it came from and how it was made.
3. **Details:** material · finish · dimensions · weight · capacity (for vessels).
4. **Variation note:** why no two are the same.
5. **Care:** how to keep it for decades.
6. **Delivery:** lead time for made-to-order, and how large pieces ship.

> **River Clay Cup**
> Thrown by hand from clay dug near the river, then fired twice. The ash glaze pools where the wall meets the base, so no two cups carry the same colour.
> Stoneware · matte ash glaze · 9 cm tall · 300 ml · 280 g
> Dishwasher safe. Not for the microwave.

> **Split Log Bench**
> Split from a single fallen oak and air-dried for two seasons before shaping. Knots, checks and the grain's own colour are left as the tree grew them.
> Solid oak · natural oil finish · 120 × 35 × 45 cm · approx. 38 kg · seats two
> Oil twice a year. Ships by freight in 2–3 weeks.

### UI vocabulary (use these exact words)

| Context | Wording |
|---|---|
| Primary purchase | **Add to Bag** (never "cart") |
| Out of stock | **Sold out** + **Notify me** |
| Save for later | **Add to wishlist** / **Remove from wishlist** (accessible names) |
| Badges | **New** · **Handmade** · **One of a kind** · **Sale** · **Sold out** · **In stock** |
| Made to order | **Made to order · ships in {n} weeks** |
| Large items | **Ships by freight** |

### Empty states & microcopy

Empty states may carry the voice, briefly: *"Your bag is empty. The shop is quiet today, but something good is waiting."* Errors never do: *"Enter a valid email address."*

### Alt text

Describe what's shown, material first: *"River clay cup with a matte grey ash glaze pooling at the base, held in one hand."* Don't start with "Image of". Decorative background textures get `alt=""`.

## 3. Foundations

### 3.1 Colour palette

The palette is **bark to sand**: one warm brown scale, a softer taupe for quiet UI, and two status colours. These are primitives; components never use them directly (see §4.2 for roles).

**Figma: [Colors page](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=210-341).** A chart of all 19 primitives (chip bound to the variable, hex, role, contrast on white and on ink, how many tokens use it) and the text/background **pairings** the components actually use, with their ratios. **Contrast (all measured, WCAG 2.x formula):**

| Foreground | Background | Ratio | Passes |
|---|---|---|---|
| brown/900 | white | 13.67 | AA text |
| brown/900 | brown/50 | 11.99 | AA text |
| brown/900 | brown/100 | 11.08 | AA text |
| brown/900 | brown/200 | 7.73 | AA text |
| brown/900 | brown/300 | 6.49 | AA text |
| brown/900 | brown/400 | 5.35 | AA text |
| brown/800 | white | 7.51 | AA text |
| brown/600 | white | 4.95 | AA text, UI boundary |
| red/600 | white | 6.54 | AA text |
| green/600 | white | 6.38 | AA text |
| white | brown/900 · red/600 · green/600 | 13.67 · 6.54 · 6.38 | AA text |
| taupe/500 | white · brown/100 | 3.29 · 2.66 | Disabled only (WCAG-exempt) |
| taupe/400 | white | 2.45 | Disabled only (WCAG-exempt) |
| taupe/200 | white | 1.40 | Decorative dividers only |

**Rules:** Text is brown/900 or brown/800 on light surfaces, never a lighter brown. Never put brown/600 or lighter text on brown/200 or darker fills. Red and green always travel with an icon or words; colour is never the only signal.

### 3.2 Type

One family: **Inter** (400 Regular, 600 Semi Bold, 700 Bold), loaded from Google Fonts, falling back to `system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif` (`--nds-font-family`).

#### Content type scale (headers & paragraph copy)

One scale for **every page that carries content**: About, Journal, category pages, product stories. A heading or paragraph looks the same wherever it appears. Sizes live in the **Typography** variable collection, which has two modes: **Desktop** (the default) and **Mobile** (below 768px). In Figma, set a frame's Typography mode; in code, the mobile values apply automatically under 768px, or you can force a mode with `data-nds-mode="mobile"`.

| Style (Figma text style) | Weight | Desktop size / line / tracking | Mobile size / line / tracking | Tokens | Use for |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Heading/H1** | 600 | 48 / 56 · −1px | 32 / 40 · −0.5px | `text/h1/*` | Page title: one per page ("Clay & ceramics", "Made from what the land lets go") |
| **Heading/H2** | 600 | 36 / 44 · −0.5px | 28 / 36 · −0.25px | `text/h2/*` | Major section of a content page ("Finding the wood") |
| **Heading/H3** | 600 | 24 / 32 · 0 | 20 / 28 · 0 | `text/h3/*` | Sub-section; product row titles ("Cups & mugs") |
| **Heading/H4** | 600 | 20 / 28 · 0 | 18 / 26 · 0 | `text/h4/*` | Small groups: care, dimensions, FAQs |
| **Paragraph/Large** | 400 | 20 / 32 | 18 / 28 | `text/paragraph-lg/*` | Intro under an H1 (one short paragraph) |
| **Paragraph/Default** | 400 | 18 / 30 | 16 / 26 | `text/paragraph/*` | Body copy: stories, articles, product descriptions |
| **Paragraph/Small** | 400 | 16 / 24 | 14 / 22 | `text/paragraph-sm/*` | Secondary copy: care notes, fine print (muted colour) |
| **Caption** | 400 | 14 / 20 | 14 / 20 | `text/caption/*` | Image captions, eyebrows ("Journal") (muted colour) |

| Spacing & measure | Desktop | Mobile | Token |
|---|---|---|---|
| Between paragraphs | 20px | 16px | `text/paragraph-spacing` |
| Below a heading | 16px | 12px | `text/space/after-heading` |
| Above an H2 / H3 | 32px (2× below) | 24px | `text/space/after-heading` × 2 |
| Top / bottom of a content section | 48px | 32px | `layout/section` |
| Max line width (paragraphs) | 640px | 343px (full column at 375) | `text/measure` |

| Colour | Value | Token |
|---|---|---|
| Headings | `#3B2A1E` (13.67:1) | `text/color/heading` |
| Paragraphs | `#3B2A1E` (13.67:1) | `text/color/paragraph` |
| Small copy & captions | `#6B4F35` (7.51:1) | `text/color/muted` |

**UI text** inside components (buttons, fields, labels, cards, navigation) keeps its fixed component sizes (§4.1): 16/24 body, 14/20 labels, 12/16 badges. The content scale is for reading.

Size primitives now run `font-size/12 · 14 · 16 · 18 · 20 · 24 · 28 · 32 · 36 · 48` with line heights `16 · 20 · 22 · 24 · 26 · 28 · 30 · 32 · 36 · 40 · 44 · 56`, and tracking `letter-spacing/tighter (−1) · tight (−0.5) · snug (−0.25) · normal (0)` in px.

#### Typography guidelines

**Hierarchy.** One clear first read per view. Today it's built from weight and colour, not size:

| Level | Style | Example |
|---|---|---|
| 1. What it is | Body Strong (600, Ink) | **River Clay Cup** |
| 2. What it costs | Body Strong (600, Ink; Critical on sale) | **$38** |
| 3. What it's made of | Small (400, Secondary) | Stoneware · ash glaze |
| 4. Supporting detail | Small / helper | Dishwasher safe |

**Page structure** (content pages and category pages alike): H1 → Paragraph/Large intro → H2 sections → H3 sub-sections → Paragraph/Default. Category pages go H1 → intro → Product Rows, whose titles are H3.

- **One H1 per page**, and never skip levels in the HTML outline (h1 → h2 → h3). The **visual** size can differ from the level when the layout needs it: a Product Row title is an `<h2>` in the outline but uses the H3 style.
- **Don't invent sizes.** If nothing in the scale fits, propose a new style rather than setting a one-off size.

**Rules**

- **Sentence case everywhere:** "Add to Bag", "Order preferences", "New arrivals". Proper nouns and "Bag" keep their capitals.
- **Line length:** 45–75 characters for product stories and descriptions (about `max-width: 38em` at 16px). Card titles: up to 2 lines.
- **Alignment:** left-aligned. Centre only single-line UI (the announcement bar, badges). Never justify.
- **Weights:** 400 for reading, 600 for emphasis and interactive labels, 700 only for the logo. No italics for emphasis; no underline except links.
- **Minimum size:** 12px, and only for badges. Everything people need to read is 14px or more; inputs are always 16px.
- **Numbers & units:**
  - Prices: `$38`, `$1,240`. No `.00`, no "USD" in the shop, and the currency symbol is always shown.
  - Measurements: `120 × 35 × 45 cm` with a real multiplication sign and a space before the unit.
  - Weight and volume: `38 kg` · `300 ml` · `280 g`.
  - Separators: a middle dot with spaces (` · `) between details. Never slashes or pipes.
- **Truncation:** clamp card titles at 2 lines with an ellipsis; never truncate prices, labels, errors or buttons. The full title must be available to screen readers.
- **Text resizing:** everything must stay readable and unclipped at 200% zoom. Use the tokens (px in CSS today), and never fix a text container's height.

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| "Split log bench" in sentence case | "SPLIT LOG BENCH" or "Split Log Bench – Hand Made!" |
| `$38` · `120 × 35 cm` · `300 ml` | `$38.00 USD` · `120x35cm` · `300ML` |
| Bold the one thing that matters (the price) | Bold whole paragraphs, or mix bold, italic and underline |
| Left-aligned product story at a readable width | Centred multi-line paragraphs, or text running the full 1440px |

**Figma: [Spacing page](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=234-2119).** Every `space/*` step with a bar bound to its variable, how many component tokens use it and what for, plus a Button, Product Card and Input marked up with their padding and gaps and the tokens behind them.

| Space | `0 · 2 · 4 · 6 · 8 · 10 · 12 · 16 · 20 · 24 · 32 · 40 · 44 · 48` |
| Fixed sizes | `16 · 28 · 40 · 52 · 56 · 72 · 120 · 280 · 320 · 350` |

Every interactive target is **at least 44px** (radio hit area 24px, which meets WCAG 2.5.8).

### 3.6 Imagery

Photography is the product's voice.

- **Crop:** 4:5 portrait in cards (280 × 350); the backdrop is brown/100 while images load.
- **Light:** natural daylight, soft shadows, true-to-life colour. Never oversaturated.
- **Backdrop:** neutral linen, plaster or wood tones close to brown/50–brown/150.
- **Show three things per product:** the whole piece, a material close-up (grain, glaze, weave) and scale or use (a person on the bench, a hand around the cup).
- **Sold out:** image at 60% opacity on a brown/50 backdrop.

**Planned:** a real photography set (the Figma Images page is empty; cards use `Image/Placeholder`).

### 3.7 Motion

Quiet and brief. Colour and border changes: 120ms ease. Product image hover zoom: `scale(1.05)` over 300ms ease. Loading spinner: one rotation every 800ms, linear. Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, the zoom is removed and the spinner slows to 2400ms (it stays, because it's the only sign of progress). Nothing else bounces, slides in, or loops.

---

## 4. Styles

Named styles built from the foundations. Each maps to the tokens a component uses; the names are the vocabulary to use in design reviews and prompts. **Figma text styles exist** for the content scale (Heading/H1–H4, Paragraph/Large · Default · Small, Caption), each bound to the Typography variables so they resize with the frame's mode. The component text styles below, and the colour and effect styles, are still expressed through variables only. **Planned:** publish those as Figma Styles with these exact names.

### 4.1 Text styles

| Style | Family / weight | Size / line height | Letter spacing | Colour | Tokens | Used in |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Logo** | Inter 700 | 24 / 32 | −0.5px | Ink | `logo/font-size`, `logo/line-height`, `logo/letter-spacing` | Logo "natural" |

### 4.2 Colour roles

Components use **roles**, never palette colours. Each role is a variable in the **Color** collection (mode Light; Dark is planned) that aliases one primitive, so a role can be retuned, or re-pointed in a future mode, in one place. Contrast is against the surface the role is meant for.

| Role | Value | Primitive | Use | Contrast |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `fg/default` | `#3B2A1E` | brown/900 | Text, icons, prices, selected marks | 13.67:1 on `bg/default` |
| `fg/muted` | `#6B4F35` | brown/800 | Secondary text: helper, meta, SKU, descriptions | 7.51:1 |
| `fg/subtle` | `#8A6A4A` | brown/600 | Placeholder, compare price, outside days, off thumb | 4.95:1 |
| `fg/disabled` | `#9C8B7A` | taupe/500 | Disabled text and marks | 3.29:1 (WCAG-exempt) |
| `fg/on-emphasis` | `#FFFFFF` | white | Text on `bg/emphasis`, `bg/sale-emphasis`, `bg/success-emphasis` | 13.67:1 on ink |
| `fg/decorative` | `#CBAE8A` | brown/300 | Placeholder glyphs only; never text | decorative |
| `fg/danger` · `fg/sale` · `fg/success` | `#B3261E` · `#B3261E` · `#2E6B3F` | red/600 · red/600 · green/600 | Errors · sale prices · success messages; always with an icon or text | 6.54 · 6.54 · 6.38 |
| `bg/default` | `#FFFFFF` | white | Page, cards, fields, menus | — |
| `bg/subtle` | `#F6EFE7` | brown/50 | Footer, read-only fields, sold-out media | — |
| `bg/muted` | `#EFE6DB` | brown/100 | Image placeholders, light badge, range band | — |
| `bg/disabled` | `#EFE6DB` | brown/100 | Disabled fills (a separate role from `bg/muted` so they can diverge) | — |
| `bg/emphasis` | `#3B2A1E` | brown/900 | Dark badge, announcement bar, selected day, filled slider track | — |
| `bg/sale-emphasis` · `bg/success-emphasis` | `#B3261E` · `#2E6B3F` | red/600 · green/600 | Sale and success badges | — |
| `bg/backdrop` | ink 40% | brown/900-a40 | Behind the mobile menu and the cart drawer | — |
| `border/default` | `#8A6A4A` | brown/600 | Field, control and secondary button borders | 4.95:1 |
| `border/hover` · `border/strong` | `#6B4F35` · `#3B2A1E` | brown/800 · brown/900 | Hovered borders · focused or checked borders, nav indicator | 7.51 · 13.67 |

| `accent/border-hover` | `#7A5C3E` | brown/700 | Primary button border on hover and press | — |
| `control/bg-hover` · `control/bg-pressed` | `#F6EFE7` · `#EADCCB` | brown/50 · brown/150 | Neutral interactive fills: secondary button, icon buttons, nav links, days, off controls | — |

### 4.3 Effect styles

| Style | Definition | Used in |
|---|---|---|
| **Focus ring** | 2px solid Ink, 2px gap (`*/focus-ring-offset` → `space/2`); radius follows the shape (8 → 12, full → full) | Every focusable control |
| **Focus ring / Card** | 2px solid Ink, 4px gap (`card/focus-ring-offset` → `space/4`), radius 8 (code) / 12 (Figma ring layer) | Product Card |
| **Shadow / Float** | `0 1px 3px` Ink at 16% (`wishlist/shadow/{y,blur,color}` → `elevation/float/*`, `color/brown/900-a16`; bound in Figma) | Wishlist Button over photos (the only shadow) |
| **Active indicator** | 2px Ink bar: under the link (Nav Link), left edge (Menu Item) | Current page |
| **Dim / Sold out** | Image opacity 60% | Product Card sold out |
| **Spin / Loading** | 360° rotation, 800ms linear, infinite; 2400ms under reduced motion | Spinner |
| **Zoom / Hover** | `scale(1.05)`, 300ms ease; removed under reduced motion | Product Card image |
| **Backdrop / Modal** | Ink at 40% (`bg/backdrop` → `color/brown/900-a40`) | Mobile Menu dialog backdrop |

### 4.4 Layout styles

| Style | Value |
|---|---|
| **Breakpoint** | Mobile layout when the header's container is narrower than **768px** (container query, not viewport) |
| **Compact breakpoint** | Components that always sit in a column (Cart Line) switch to their compact (Figma Mobile) sizes when **they themselves** are narrower than **480px**; the page breakpoint would misfire in a 720px desktop column |
| **Page gutter** | 40px desktop (`layout/page-margin`), 16px mobile (`layout/page-margin` (Mobile)) |
| **Header height** | 72px desktop, 56px mobile; announcement bar 36px (8 + 20 + 8) |
| **Product card width** | 280px standalone; fills its column in a Product Row. Media is always 4:5 |
| **Product grid** | 4 columns ≥ 768px (24px gaps, 40px margins, 48px top/bottom) · 2 columns below (16px gaps, 16px margins, 32px top/bottom); container query |
| **Form field width** | 320px default |
| **Stack gaps** | Label→field 6 · field→helper 6 · card media→info 12 · info lines 4 · radio options 12 · toggle control→text 12 · toggle rows 16 |

**Page grid** ([Figma: Grid page](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=210-342)): grid styles **Grid/Desktop** and **Grid/Mobile**, applied to any page frame.

| | Desktop (1440) | Mobile (375) |
|---|---|---|
| Columns | 12 | 4 |
| Margin | 40 (`layout/page-margin`) | 16 (`layout/page-margin` (Mobile)) |
| Gutter | 24 (`layout/gutter`) | 16 (`layout/gutter` (Mobile)) |
| Product Card | 3 of 12 (322px) | 2 of 4 (163.5px) |
| Half-page Image Block + copy | 6 + 6, full bleed | 4 of 4, stacked |
| Hero, Banner | full bleed | full bleed |

The grid's margin and gutter are bound to the Product Row tokens in Figma, so the grid and the rows can't drift apart. In code, layout comes from the components themselves (Product Row's container query), so there is no separate grid utility yet.

## 5. Tokens

Tokens are **tiered**: raw values at the bottom, meaning above them, and components only at the top when a value belongs to one component alone. Figma variables and `tokens/figma-variables.json` are identical (checked by the parity gate), and the CSS is generated from the JSON.

```
Primitives  ──▶  Color · Dimension  ──▶  Layout · Typography  ──▶  Component
raw values       semantic roles          responsive roles          one-off decisions
86 variables     32 · 9                  4 · 40                    41
```

| Collection | Modes | What goes in it | Examples |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Primitives** | — | The palette and every scale step. Colour, size, type and elevation are hidden from Figma's pickers; **space, radius and border width are the public scale**, bound directly. | `color/brown/900`, `space/12`, `radius/8`, `border-width/1` |
| **Color** | Light (Dark planned) | What a colour *means* (§4.2) | `fg/muted`, `bg/emphasis`, `border/hover`, `accent/bg` |
| **Dimension** | — | Sizes and focus geometry shared across components | `size/control` (44), `size/target-min` (24), `size/icon-md`, `focus/ring-width` |
| **Layout** | Desktop · Mobile | Responsive page rhythm | `layout/page-margin` (40 / 16), `layout/gutter`, `layout/section`, `layout/header-height` |
| **Typography** | Desktop · Mobile | The content scale (§3.2) and UI type roles | `text/h1/font-size`, `ui/label/font-size`, `ui/body/line-height` |
| **Component** | Desktop · Mobile | A decision unique to one component that no role describes | `card/width`, `calendar/day/size`, `toggle/track-width`, `image/hero/height` |

**Rules** (enforced, not just written down):
1. **Components use roles.** Component CSS and Figma layers bind Color, Dimension, Layout and Typography, plus the public scale. Using a hidden primitive such as `--nds-color-brown-900` fails validate_file (`tier-primitive`), and the fix names the roles that alias it.
2. **Component tokens are the exception.** Add one only when the value is a decision of that component alone. A component never uses another component's token (`tier-component`).
3. **One hop.** Every token aliases a primitive directly: no role-of-a-role. The governance gate rejects any alias that isn't a primitive.
4. **Responsive values are modes, not twins.** `layout/page-margin` is 40 in Desktop and 16 in Mobile. There are no `-mobile` tokens.
5. **Scopes keep pickers honest.** In Figma, a text-colour picker offers only `fg/*`, a stroke picker `border/*` and `focus/ring`, a gap picker `space/*` and the layout roles.

**Naming.** `group/role` or `group/role-state`, lowercase kebab-case: `fg/muted`, `control/bg-pressed`, `layout/gutter`, `ui/label/font-size`. Component tokens start with the component: `calendar/day/size`. The Figma name `fg/muted` is the CSS variable `--nds-fg-muted`.

**Modes in code.** Desktop values sit on `:root`; Mobile values apply below 768px and under `[data-nds-mode="mobile"]` (like a frame's mode in Figma). Each moded token also has constants, `--nds-layout-gutter--desktop` and `--nds-layout-gutter--mobile`, for components that switch on their own width: inside `@container (max-width: 767px)` a Product Row uses `var(--nds-layout-gutter--mobile)`. In Figma, Mobile variants set the Layout and Component collections to Mobile, and Desktop variants pin Desktop.

**Adding a value.** Work down this list and stop at the first yes:
1. Is it already a role? Use it (`fg/muted`, `size/control`).
2. Is it a step of the public scale? Bind it (`space/12`, `radius/8`).
3. Would two or more components use it with the same meaning? Propose a role in Color, Dimension, Layout or Typography (GOVERNANCE.md §4).
4. Otherwise, add a Component token named for its component.

Then: edit `tokens/figma-variables.json`, run `npm run tokens`, mirror the change in Figma (`npm run figma:sync-script`), refresh the parity snapshot, and run `npm run check`.

**Migration from 0.13.** The component-scoped tokens (569 variables across 18 collections) became 212 variables across 6. Every retired name and its replacement is in `tokens/migrations/0.14.0-semantic-tokens.json`; the old CSS names still work through `src/styles/tokens-deprecated.css` until they are removed in 0.16 (D-030, D-031).

---

## 6. Components

Every component exists in Figma and code with the same name, variants and states. Each has a Storybook **All Variants** story laid out like its Figma grid (State columns, variant rows) with a link to its Figma node. States called `forceState` in code exist only so docs can show hover, pressed and focus without interaction; real interaction uses CSS `:hover`, `:active` and `:focus-visible`.

Each component ends with the same two blocks:

- **Do / Don't:** ✅ good vs ❌ bad pairs, using Natural's own products and copy where it helps.
- **Keyboard & screen reader:** what each key does and what assistive technology announces, as the code behaves today.

Import everything from the package root:

```tsx
import { Button, Badge, TextField, TextArea, DateField, Calendar, CalendarDay, ImageBlock, Footer, Slider, RangeSlider, CartLine, CartDrawer, TextButton, Radio, RadioGroup, Toggle, WishlistButton, ProductCard, ProductRow,
  NavigationMenu, MobileMenu, NavLink, NavMenuButton, NavDropdown, NavGroup,
  IconButton, MenuItem, Logo, Spinner, Heading, Text } from 'natural-design-system';
import 'natural-design-system/styles.css';
```

### 6.1 Logo

[Figma 153:822](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=153-822) · [Storybook](https://chris-terterian.github.io/natural-design-system/?path=/docs/components-logo--docs)

Its own component (and Figma page) since 0.5.0 (D-021); Navigation Menu and Mobile Menu nest it as an instance.

**Purpose:** the Natural wordmark, linking home. **Anatomy:** ① Wordmark "natural".

| Figma property | Type | Default | Code prop | Default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| State | Variant | Default | `forceState` | `undefined` (`'focus'` for docs only; real focus uses `:focus-visible`) |
| none | | | `href` | `'/'` (plus native anchor attributes) |

**Tokens (Logo collection):** `fg/default` (13.67:1), `logo/font-size`, `logo/line-height`, `logo/letter-spacing` (tight, −0.5px), `focus/ring`, `focus/ring-width`, `focus/ring-offset`, `radius/8`. **States:** Default, Focus (2px ring, 2px gap, radius 8). **Clear space:** at least 16px (`space/16`) on every side.
**Accessibility:** rendered as a link with `aria-label="Natural — home"`.
**Rule:** the same wordmark on every breakpoint; never add a tagline or descriptor beside it.

**Do / Don't**

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Use the wordmark "natural" as is, in Ink on a light surface. | Recolour it, stretch it, add a leaf icon or a tagline next to it. |
| Link it to the home page. | Make it a static image with no link, or link it anywhere else. |
| Keep at least 16px of clear space around it. | Crowd it against nav links or the announcement bar. |

**Keyboard & screen reader**

| Key / event | Result |
|---|---|
| Tab | Focuses the logo (focus ring appears) |
| Enter | Goes home |
| Announced | "Natural — home, link" |

### 6.2 Button

[Figma 1:202](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=1-202) · [Storybook](https://chris-terterian.github.io/natural-design-system/?path=/story/components-button--all-variants)

**Purpose:** actions. **Primary** (sand fill) for the one main action per view (Add to Bag); **Secondary** (white, outlined) for everything else (Notify me, Cancel).
**Anatomy:** ① Container · ② Left icon (optional) · ③ Label · ④ Right icon (optional) · ⑤ Spinner (Loading) · ⑥ Focus ring.

| Figma property | Type | Values / default | Code prop | Type / default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Style | Variant | Primary, Secondary | `variant` | `'primary' \| 'secondary'` = `'primary'` |
| Icon | Variant | None, Left, Right, Both | `leftIcon`, `rightIcon` | `ReactNode` |
| State | Variant | Default, Hover, Pressed, Focus, Disabled, Loading | `disabled`, `loading`, `forceState` | `boolean`; `boolean`; `'hover' \| 'pressed' \| 'focus'` |
| Label | Text | "Button" | `children` | `ReactNode` (required) |
| Left icon | Instance swap | Icon/Plus | `leftIcon` | |
| Right icon | Instance swap | Icon/Arrow Right | `rightIcon` | |
| Full width | instance sizing | set the instance to **Fill container** | `fullWidth` | `boolean` = `false` |
| none | | | `type` | `'button'` (plus all native button attributes) |

| Layout | Token | Value |
|---|---|---|
| Min height | `size/control` | 44px |
| Padding | `space/12` · `space/24` | 12 · 24px |
| Padding on an icon side | `space/20` | 20px |
| Icon–label gap | `space/8` | 8px |
| Radius | `radius/8` | 8px |
| Border | `border-width/1` | 1px |
| Text | Button style | 16 / 20, 600 |
| Icon · spinner | `size/icon-md` | 20px |

| State | Primary bg / text / border | Secondary bg / text / border |
|---|---|---|
| Default | `#D8BFA0` / `#3B2A1E` / `#8A6A4A` (7.73:1) | `#FFFFFF` / `#3B2A1E` / `#8A6A4A` (13.67:1) |
| Hover | `#CBAE8A` / `#3B2A1E` / `#7A5C3E` (6.49:1) | `#F6EFE7` / `#3B2A1E` / `#6B4F35` (11.99:1) |
| Pressed | `#BC9D76` / `#3B2A1E` / `#7A5C3E` (5.35:1) | `#EADCCB` / `#3B2A1E` / `#6B4F35` (10.16:1) |
| Focus | Default + focus ring (2px `#3B2A1E`, 2px gap, radius 12) | same |
| Disabled | `#EFE6DB` / `#9C8B7A` / `#DCCFBF` (exempt) | `#FFFFFF` / `#B3A392` / `#E3D8CB` (exempt) |
| Loading | Default colours; label and icons invisible (width kept); Spinner centred in `fg/default` `#3B2A1E` | same |

**Behaviour & accessibility:** native `<button>`; `type="button"` by default. Icons are decorative (`aria-hidden`); the label names the action. **Loading** sets `aria-busy="true"` and `aria-disabled="true"` and ignores clicks; the label is hidden with `opacity: 0` (never `visibility: hidden`) so the button keeps its accessible name. Use it after the click (e.g. while adding to the bag), not as a default state. **Full width** is for narrow containers: product cards, mobile sheets, forms.

**Do / Don't**

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| One Primary per area: **Add to Bag** (Primary) beside **Notify me** (Secondary). | Two Primaries side by side: **Add to Bag** + **Buy now**, both sand. |
| Verb-first, specific labels: "Add to Bag", "Save address". | Vague or shouty labels: "OK", "Submit", "CLICK HERE!". |
| Use Loading after the click while the action runs. | Leave the button active so it can be pressed twice, or disable it with no explanation. |
| Use a link for navigation ("View the collection"). | Use a Button to change pages. |
| Put icons only where they add meaning (Plus for add, Arrow for continue). | Add decorative icons to every button, or make an icon-only Button (use Icon Button). |
| Use Full width in narrow containers (cards, mobile sheets). | Stretch buttons full width on wide desktop layouts. |

**Keyboard & screen reader**

| Key / event | Result |
|---|---|
| Tab | Focuses the button; focus ring appears |
| Enter / Space | Activates it (ignored while Loading) |
| Announced | "Add to Bag, button"; while loading: "Add to Bag, button, busy, dimmed/unavailable" (wording varies by screen reader) |
| Disabled | Skipped by Tab; announced as dimmed/unavailable if reached by a screen reader |

### 6.3 Badge

[Figma 2:171](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=2-171) · [Storybook](https://chris-terterian.github.io/natural-design-system/?path=/story/components-badge--all-variants)

**Purpose:** short status labels on products; counts on the Bag icon. **Anatomy:** ① Pill container · ② Label.

| Figma property | Type | Values / default | Code prop | Type / default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tone | Variant | Dark, Light, Sale, Success, Outline | `tone` | `'dark' \| 'light' \| 'sale' \| 'success' \| 'outline'` = `'dark'` |
| Label | Text | "Badge" | `children` | `ReactNode` |

| Layout | Token | Value |
|---|---|---|
| Padding | `space/2` · `space/8` | 2 · 8px |
| Radius | `radius/full` | full |
| Border (inset) | `border-width/1` | 1px |
| Text | Badge style | 12 / 16, 600 |

| Tone | Background | Text | Border | Contrast | Use for |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dark | `#3B2A1E` | `#FFFFFF` | `#3B2A1E` | 13.67 | New, bag count |
| Light | `#EFE6DB` | `#3B2A1E` | `#EFE6DB` | 11.08 | Handmade, One of a kind **on white surfaces only** |
| Sale | `#B3261E` | `#FFFFFF` | `#B3261E` | 6.54 | Sale |
| Success | `#2E6B3F` | `#FFFFFF` | `#2E6B3F` | 6.38 | In stock |
| Outline | `#FFFFFF` | `#3B2A1E` | `#8A6A4A` | 13.67 | Sold out |

**Rules:** one or two words; the words carry the meaning, tone only reinforces it. Not interactive. Use at most one badge per product card.

**Do / Don't**

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| One or two words from the vocabulary: **Handmade**, **One of a kind**, **Sold out**. | Sentences or claims: "Handmade & eco-friendly!", "Best seller of the season". |
| One badge per card, top-left of the image. | Stack several badges, or place them over the product itself. |
| On product images use Dark, Sale or Outline ("Handmade" → Dark). | Use Light on images: its fill matches the image backdrop and the pill disappears. |
| A sold-out piece keeps its **Sold out** badge. | Replace "Sold out" with another label ("One of a kind"), hiding that it's unavailable. |
| Match tone to meaning: Sale = Sale tone, Sold out = Outline. | Use Sale red for "New", or Success green for decoration. |
| Let the words carry the meaning. | Rely on colour alone (a red dot, an empty coloured pill). |

**Keyboard & screen reader**

| Key / event | Result |
|---|---|
| Tab | Not focusable (static text) |
| Announced | Read inline as plain text in reading order, e.g. "Handmade". The bag count badge is hidden (`aria-hidden`) because the Icon Button name already says "Bag, 2 items". |

|---|---|
| A visible label that names the data: "Email". | Placeholder as the label ("Enter your email…" with no label). |
| Placeholder as an example: `you@example.com`. | Placeholder as an instruction that disappears when typing. |
| Errors that say how to fix: "Enter a valid email address." | Errors that blame or puzzle: "Invalid input", "Error 422". |
| Show the error only after the person leaves the field or submits. | Flag errors on the first keystroke. |
| Helper text for format or reassurance: "We'll never share your email." | Long paragraphs of helper text, or helper text that repeats the label. |
| Use the right input type and autocomplete (`type="email"`, `autocomplete="email"`). | Use a plain text field for email, phone or postcode. |

**Keyboard & screen reader**

| Key / event | Result |
|---|---|
| Tab | Focuses the field; border darkens and the focus ring appears |
| Typing | Edits the value (read-only: selectable, not editable; disabled: skipped by Tab) |
| Announced | "Email, edit text, We'll never share your email." In error: "invalid entry" plus the error message (via `aria-invalid` and `aria-describedby`) |

### 6.5 Text Area

[Figma 1:498](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=1-498) (Type=Textarea) · [Storybook](https://chris-terterian.github.io/natural-design-system/?path=/story/components-input--textarea)

Same properties, states and colours as Text Field (§6.4), plus:

| Difference | Figma | Code |
|---|---|---|
| Height | Field fixed at `input/textarea-height` = 120px, text top-aligned | `resize: vertical` |
| Resize grip | 8px diagonal grip, bottom-right, `fg/muted` | native |
| Counter | "n/200" right of helper, Small style | `maxLength` shows a live `n/max` counter (`aria-live="polite"`) |

**Do / Don't**

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Use for free text: gift messages, order notes, reviews. | Use for short single values (name, email). |
| Show a counter when there's a limit: "73/200". | Cut text off silently at the limit. |
| Label the purpose: "Gift message". | Label it "Comments" when you mean something specific. |

**Keyboard & screen reader**

| Key / event | Result |
|---|---|
| Tab | Focuses the text area |
| Enter | New line (it does not submit the form) |
| Announced | Label, "edit text, multi-line", helper text; the counter updates politely (`aria-live="polite"`) |

### 6.6 Radio

[Figma 1:637](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=1-637) · [Storybook](https://chris-terterian.github.io/natural-design-system/?path=/story/components-radio--all-variants)

**Purpose:** one choice from a short list (shipping method, size; wood finish until swatches exist). **Anatomy:** ① 24px hit area · ② 20px circle · ③ 8px dot (checked) · ④ Label · ⑤ Description (optional) · ⑥ Focus ring.

| Figma property | Type | Values / default | Code prop | Type / default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Checked | Variant | False, True | `checked` / `defaultChecked` (or from `RadioGroup` value) | `boolean` |
| State | Variant | Default, Hover, Pressed, Focus, Disabled, Error | `disabled`, `invalid`, `forceState` | `boolean`; `boolean`; `'hover' \| 'pressed' \| 'focus'` |
| Label | Text | "Label" | `label` | `ReactNode` (required) |
| Description | Text | "Description" | `description` | `ReactNode` |
| Show description | Boolean | false | `description` | omit to hide |
| none | | | `value`, `name` | native |

| Layout | Token | Value |
|---|---|---|
| Hit area · circle · dot | `size/target-min` · `radio/size` · `radio/dot-size` | 24 · 20 · 8px |
| Circle border | `border-width/1-5` | 1.5px |
| Control→text gap | `space/8` | 8px |
| Focus ring | `radio/focus-ring-size` · `focus/ring-width` | 28px circle · 2px |
| Text | Body (label), Small (description) | |

| State | Unchecked bg / border | Checked bg / border / dot |
|---|---|---|
| Default | `#FFFFFF` / `#8A6A4A` | `#D8BFA0` / `#3B2A1E` / `#3B2A1E` (dot 7.73:1) |
| Hover | `#F6EFE7` / `#6B4F35` | `#CBAE8A` / `#3B2A1E` / `#3B2A1E` |
| Pressed | `#EADCCB` / `#6B4F35` | `#BC9D76` / `#3B2A1E` / `#3B2A1E` |
| Focus | Default + 28px ring | Default + 28px ring |
| Disabled | `#EFE6DB` / `#DCCFBF`, text `#9C8B7A` | `#EFE6DB` / `#DCCFBF` / `#9C8B7A` |
| Error | `#FFFFFF` / `#B3261E` | `#D8BFA0` / `#B3261E` / `#3B2A1E` |

Label `#3B2A1E` (13.67), description `#6B4F35` (7.51).

**Do / Don't**

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Use for 2–6 mutually exclusive options that should all be visible: shipping method, ring size. | Use for on/off (use Toggle) or for long lists (use a select; **Planned**). |
| Pre-select the sensible default when there is one (Standard shipping). | Pre-select an option that costs more. |
| Short labels, detail in the description: "Express" / "2–3 business days · $12". | Put price and timing in a long label. |
| Keep the disabled option visible with the reason: "Unavailable for this address". | Hide unavailable options with no explanation. |

**Keyboard & screen reader**

| Key / event | Result |
|---|---|
| Tab | Enters the group on the selected option (or the first); Tab again leaves the group |
| ↑ ↓ ← → | Moves to and selects the previous or next option (disabled options are skipped) |
| Space | Selects the focused option |
| Announced | "Express, radio button, checked, 2 of 3, 2–3 business days · $12", after the group legend |

### 6.7 Radio Group

Code only (`RadioGroup`); shown in Figma as the "Shipping method" and "Ring size" examples on the Radio Buttons page. [Storybook](https://chris-terterian.github.io/natural-design-system/?path=/story/components-radio--shipping-method)

| Code prop | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `legend` | `ReactNode` (required) | Rendered as `<legend>`, Label style |
| `value`, `onChange` | `string`, `(value) => void` | Controlled selection |
| `name` | `string` | Auto-generated if omitted |
| `error` | `ReactNode` | Group error: Alert icon + message in Critical, marks every radio invalid |
| `children` | `Radio` elements | 12px apart; legend 12px above |

**Rules:** always use a group with a legend; show errors once at group level, never per option.

**Do / Don't**

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| A legend that asks the question: "Shipping method". | Radios with no legend, or a legend like "Options". |
| One group error: "Select a ring size to continue." | An error under every option. |
| Stack options vertically. | Put options in a row where labels wrap unevenly. |

**Keyboard & screen reader**

| Key / event | Result |
|---|---|
| Tab / arrows | As Radio; the group is one Tab stop |
| Announced | The legend when entering ("Shipping method, group"), then the option; with an error, the group is marked invalid and the message is read |

| Selected | Variant | False, True | `selected` / `defaultSelected`, `onChange` | `boolean` / `false`; `(selected) => void` |
| State | Variant | Default, Hover, Pressed, Focus | `forceState` | `'hover' \| 'pressed' \| 'focus'` |
| none | | | `productName` | `string`, used in the accessible name |

| Layout / state | Value |
|---|---|

**Do / Don't**

### 6.9 Product Card

[Figma 1:968](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=1-968) · [Storybook](https://chris-terterian.github.io/natural-design-system/?path=/story/components-product-card--all-variants)

**Purpose:** a product in a listing. **Anatomy:** ① Media (4:5 image) · ② Badge (top-left, nested Badge) · ③ Wishlist Button (top-right, nested) · ④ Title (link) · ⑤ Meta · ⑥ Price (+ compare price) · ⑦ CTA (nested Button) · ⑧ Focus ring.

| Figma property | Type | Values / default | Code prop | Type / default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Status | Variant | Default, Sale, Sold out | `status` | `'default' \| 'sale' \| 'sold-out'` = `'default'` |
| State | Variant | Default, Hover, Focus | `forceState` | `'hover' \| 'focus'` |
| Title | Text | "Product name" | `title` | `string` (required) |
| Meta | Text | "14k gold · 3 colors" | `meta` | `string` |
| Price | Text | "$120" | `price` | `string` (required) |
| Compare price | Text | "$150" | `comparePrice` | `string` (shown when sale) |
| Show badge | Boolean | true | `badge` | `string \| false`; default by status: New / Sale / Sold out |
| Badge (nested, exposed) | Tone + Label | Dark·New / Sale·Sale / Outline·Sold out | `badgeTone` | `BadgeTone`; default by status |
| Show wishlist | Boolean | true | `showWishlist`, `wishlisted`, `onWishlistChange` | `true`; `boolean`; handler |
| Show CTA | Boolean | true | `showCta`, `onAddToCart`, `onNotify` | `true`; handlers |
| Image | Instance swap | Image/Placeholder | `imageSrc`, `imageAlt` | `string`; `''` |
| none | | | `href` | `string` (required), the title link |

| Layout | Token | Value |
|---|---|---|
| Width · media | `card/width` · aspect ratio | 280px standalone (fills its column in a Product Row) · media always 4:5 (280 × 350 at default width) |
| Media radius | `radius/8` | 8px |
| Badge / wishlist inset | `space/12` | 12px |
| Info side padding | `space/12` | 12px, so the name, meta and price line up with the badge and the wishlist button |
| Media→info, info→CTA gap | `space/12` | 12px |
| Info line gap | `space/4` | 4px (the info block grows, so CTAs align when cards share a row) |
| Price gap | `space/8` | 8px |
| Text | Body Strong (title, price), Small (meta, compare price) | |

| Status | Badge | Price | Media | CTA |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Default | Dark "New" | `#3B2A1E` | `#EFE6DB` backdrop | Primary "Add to Bag" |
| Sale | Sale "Sale" | Sale `#B3261E` (6.54) + struck `#8A6A4A` (4.95) | `#EFE6DB` | Primary "Add to Bag" |
| Sold out | Outline "Sold out" | `#3B2A1E` | `#F6EFE7`, image 60% | Secondary "Notify me" |

| State | Change |
|---|---|
| Hover | Image zoom 5%, title underlined |
| Focus | 2px Ink ring around the whole card, 4px gap (title link has keyboard focus) |

**Behaviour & accessibility:** the whole card is clickable through the title link (stretched link); the wishlist and CTA sit above it as separate focus stops. The sale price is announced as "Sale price … Original price …".
**Rules:** meta is material first (*"Stoneware · ash glaze"*). One badge maximum. Never hide the price.

**Do / Don't**

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Meta is material first: "Stoneware · ash glaze". | Marketing meta: "Our best-loved cup!". |
| Show real photography cropped 4:5 on a neutral backdrop. | Mixed crops, busy backgrounds, heavy filters. |
| Sale shows both prices: **$32** ~~$38~~ plus the Sale badge. | A red price with no original price or badge. |
| Sold out stays visible with "Notify me". | Remove sold-out one-of-a-kind pieces without a trace. |
| Keep titles to two lines: "Split Log Bench". | Stuff the title: "Split Log Bench – Rustic Oak Seat – Handmade – Free Shipping". |

**Keyboard & screen reader**

| Key / event | Result |
|---|---|
| Tab order | Title link → Wishlist Button → Add to Bag / Notify me (three stops per card). The wishlist comes after the title in the markup and is positioned over the image by CSS, so people meet the product before its actions (D-012). |
| Enter on the title | Opens the product (the whole card surface is this link for mouse users) |
| Announced | Title as a link inside a heading; meta; prices as "Sale price $32, Original price $38"; badge text; the image's alt text |

[Figma 60:69](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=60-69) · [Storybook](https://chris-terterian.github.io/natural-design-system/?path=/story/components-navigation-menu--icon-buttons)

**Purpose:** icon-only actions in the header (Search, Account, Wishlist, Bag, Menu, Close). **Anatomy:** ① 44px circle · ② Icon (24px) · ③ Count (nested Badge, Dark) · ④ Focus ring.

| Figma property | Type | Values / default | Code prop | Type / default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| State | Variant | Default, Hover, Pressed, Focus | `forceState` | `'hover' \| 'pressed' \| 'focus'` |
| Icon | Instance swap | Icon/Search | `icon` | `ReactNode` (required) |
| Show count | Boolean | false | `count` | `number` (hidden when 0 or omitted). Shown as a Dark Badge, a 20 × 20 circle for one digit (`nav/count-size`, padding `nav/count-padding-x`), a pill for more; it overhangs the button, so containers must not clip it |
| none | | | `label` | `string` (required), the accessible name |

| State | Background | Icon |
|---|---|---|
| Default | transparent | `#3B2A1E` |
| Hover | `#F6EFE7` | `#3B2A1E` |
| Pressed | `#EADCCB` | `#3B2A1E` |
| Focus | transparent + 52px ring, 2px, 2px gap | `#3B2A1E` |

**Accessibility:** the name includes the count: "Bag, 2 items". The visual count badge is `aria-hidden`.

**Do / Don't**

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Use recognised icons only: Search, Account, Wishlist, Bag, Menu, Close. | Invent icons for actions that need words. |
| Give every button a name, including state: "Bag, 2 items". | Leave it unnamed or named by the icon ("Magnifier"). |
| Keep the 44px target even though the icon is 24px. | Shrink the target to the icon size. |

**Keyboard & screen reader**

| Key / event | Result |
|---|---|
| Tab · Enter / Space | Focus · activate |
| Announced | "Search, button"; "Bag, 2 items, button"; Menu adds "collapsed / expanded, has popup dialog" |

### 6.11 Nav Link

[Figma 60:88](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=60-88) · [Storybook](https://chris-terterian.github.io/natural-design-system/?path=/story/components-navigation-menu--nav-links)

**Purpose:** top-level desktop navigation. A plain Nav Link goes to a page; a Nav Link with a menu is a **disclosure button** that opens a Nav Dropdown. **Anatomy:** ① Label · ② Chevron (menu only) · ③ Active indicator · ④ Focus ring.

| Figma property | Type | Values / default | Code | Type / default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| State | Variant | Default, Hover, Active, Focus, **Open** | `NavLink` `active`, `forceState`; `NavMenuButton` `expanded` | `boolean`; `'hover' \| 'focus' \| 'open'`; `boolean` |
| Label | Text | "Link" | `children` | `ReactNode` |
| Has menu | Boolean | false | `NavMenuButton` (with `controls`, `onClick`) vs `NavLink` | Navigation Menu picks it from `item.menu` |
| none | | | `href` (NavLink) | native anchor attributes |

| Layout / state | Value |
|---|---|
| Padding | 10px vertical, 4px horizontal; chevron 16px, 4px gap |
| Default | Body, `#3B2A1E` |
| Hover | underline |
| Active (current section) | Body Strong + 2px indicator bar under the link; `aria-current="page"` |
| **Open** | background `#F6EFE7` (`control/bg-hover`), chevron rotated up; indicator and bold hidden while open; `aria-expanded="true"` |
| Focus | ring 2px, 2px gap, radius 8 |

**Do / Don't**

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| 4–6 top-level links with short nouns: Shop, Collections, Journal. | Eight or more links, or phrases ("Discover our story"). |
| Mark the current section (indicator + semibold). | Show the current page by colour only. |
| Use a chevron only when the item opens a Nav Dropdown. | Show a chevron on an item with no menu (it promises something that isn't there). |
| Open menus on click / Enter / Space. | Open on hover only: it fails keyboard and touch users and fires by accident. |

**Keyboard & screen reader**

| Key / event | Result |
|---|---|
| Tab · Enter | Plain link: focus · follow the link |
| Enter / Space on a menu item | Opens or closes its dropdown (`aria-expanded` toggles); Tab then moves into the dropdown links |
| Escape | Closes the open dropdown and returns focus to its button |
| Click outside / open another | Closes the current dropdown |
| Announced | "Shop, link, current page", or for a menu: "Shop, button, collapsed / expanded" |

[Figma 60:107](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=60-107) · [Storybook](https://chris-terterian.github.io/natural-design-system/?path=/story/components-navigation-menu--menu-items)

[Figma 61:134](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=61-134) · [Storybook](https://chris-terterian.github.io/natural-design-system/?path=/story/components-navigation-menu--all-variants)

**Purpose:** the site header. **Anatomy:** ① Announcement bar · ② Bar · ③ Logo · ④ Nav Links (desktop) · ⑤ Leading actions: Menu, Search (mobile) · ⑥ Actions: Search, Account (desktop only), Wishlist, Bag.

| Figma property | Type | Values / default | Code prop | Type / default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Breakpoint | Variant | Desktop, Mobile | automatic | container query at 768px |
| Show buttons | Variant (True / False, shown as a toggle) | **False** | `showButtons` | `boolean` · `false` |
| Show announcement | Boolean | true | `announcement` | `string \| false` |
| Announcement | Text | "Free shipping on orders over $75" | `announcement` | same default |
| none | | | `items`, `accountItems` | `NavItem[]`: `label`, `href`, `active?`, `menu?` (`{ groups: { title, links }[], viewAll? }`) |
| none | | | `defaultOpenMenu` | `string` (docs only: open a dropdown on first render) |
| none | | | `bagCount`, `onSearch`, `onBag` | `number`; handlers |

| Layout | Desktop | Mobile |
|---|---|---|
| Width in Figma | 1440 | 375 |
| Announcement | Ink bar, 8px vertical padding, Small text in white (13.67), centred | same |
| Bar height | 72px (`layout/header-height`) | 56px (`layout/header-height` (Mobile)) |

| Left | Logo | Menu + Search |
| Centre | Nav Links, 32px apart | Logo |

**Do / Don't**

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| One short announcement: "Free shipping on orders over $75". | Rotating or scrolling announcements, or more than one line. |
| Keep the header the same on every page. | Hide the Bag or Search on some pages. |
| Show the bag count when there are items. | Show "0" in the badge. |

**Keyboard & screen reader**

| Key / event | Result |
|---|---|
| Tab order | Desktop: Logo → nav links (Shop and Collections are menu buttons) → Search → Account → Wishlist → Bag; an open dropdown's links come next after its button. Mobile: Menu → Search → Logo → Wishlist → Bag. The announcement is text, not a stop |
| Announced | A "banner" header landmark containing "Main, navigation" with a list of 5 links |

### 6.14 Mobile Menu

[Figma 83:571](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=83-571) · [Storybook](https://chris-terterian.github.io/natural-design-system/?path=/story/components-navigation-menu--mobile-menu-open)

**Purpose:** navigation on small screens, two levels deep. **Full screen on phones; on wider screens a left-anchored sheet capped at 480px** (`nav/mobile-menu/max-width`) over the backdrop. The header can switch to its mobile layout inside a narrow container on a wide screen, and the modal always opens over the whole viewport, so the cap keeps it phone-shaped. **Anatomy (Level = Main):** ① Bar (Close · Logo · Bag) · ② Primary links (Menu Items; sections with a menu show a chevron) · ③ Account links pinned to the bottom. **Anatomy (Level = Submenu):** ① Bar (Back · section title · Close) · ② "Shop all" · ③ Groups: group title + Menu Items.

| Figma property | Values | Code prop | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Level | Main, Submenu | internal state (`initialLevel` for docs) | A Menu Item with `hasSubmenu` opens its section's Submenu; the current section keeps its indicator (`aria-current="true"` on the button) |
| none | | `open`, `onClose` | Controlled; `NavigationMenu` manages this |
| none | | `items`, `accountItems`, `bagCount` | Submenu content comes from `item.menu` (same data as the desktop dropdown) |
| none | | `inline` | Documentation only: renders without the modal |

**Behaviour & accessibility:** native `<dialog>` opened with `showModal()`; focus is trapped. Opening a submenu moves focus to **Back**; Back returns to Main and refocuses the item that opened it; Close or Escape closes the dialog from either level and returns focus to the header Menu button. The backdrop uses Backdrop / Modal. Content taller than the screen scrolls. Size in Figma 375 × 812.

**Do / Don't**

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Open full screen as a modal and trap focus. | Slide in a panel that lets focus escape to the page behind. |
| Keep the same sections and groups as the desktop dropdown. | Maintain a separate mobile-only menu structure. |
| Put "Shop all" first in a submenu. | Hide the section's landing page. |
| Close on Close, Escape, and after choosing a link. | Require the Close button as the only way out. |

**Keyboard & screen reader**

| Key / event | Result |
|---|---|
| Open | Focus moves into the dialog (first stop: Close) |
| Enter / Space on "Shop" | Opens the Shop submenu; focus moves to "Back to menu" |
| Back | Returns to Main; focus returns to "Shop" |
| Tab / Shift+Tab | Cycles within the menu only |
| Escape | Closes the menu from either level; focus returns to the Menu button |
| Announced | "Menu, dialog"; submenu links are in a navigation region named after the section ("Shop, navigation") |

### 6.15 Image Placeholder

[Figma 1:816](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=1-816): a `#EFE6DB` frame with the image icon in `#CBAE8A`, used as the Product Card's default Image. In code, `ProductCard` renders it automatically when `imageSrc` is missing. Replace with real photography before launch.

**Do / Don't**

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Use it in designs and prototypes only. | Ship it to production in place of a product photo. |
| Treat it as decorative. | Give it alt text like "placeholder image". |

**Keyboard & screen reader:** not focusable; hidden from assistive technology.

### 6.16 Spinner

[Figma 64:50](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=64-50) · [Storybook](https://chris-terterian.github.io/natural-design-system/?path=/story/components-spinner--default)

**Purpose:** an indeterminate loading indicator, used inside Button's Loading state. **Anatomy:** ① Track (full circle, 25% opacity) · ② Arc (quarter circle, round cap).

| Property | Token | Value |
|---|---|---|
| Size | `size/icon-md` | 20px |
| Stroke | none | 2px |
| Colour | `fg/default` | `#3B2A1E` |
| Motion | Spin / Loading (§4.3) | 800ms per turn; 2400ms under reduced motion |

**Accessibility:** decorative (`aria-hidden`). The control that owns it must announce the busy state (`aria-busy`) or show text.

**Do / Don't**

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Use inside a Button's Loading state for short waits. | Use a spinner on its own to cover a whole page. |
| Keep the button's label in place (hidden) so its name stays. | Replace the label with the spinner so the name is lost. |

**Keyboard & screen reader:** not focusable; hidden. The owning Button announces "busy".

### 6.17 Toggle

[Figma 67:360](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=67-360) · [Storybook](https://chris-terterian.github.io/natural-design-system/?path=/story/components-toggle--all-variants)

**Purpose:** turn a single setting on or off, taking effect immediately: gift wrap, back-in-stock emails, "show only handmade" filters. **When not to use:** choosing between options (use Radio Group), or a choice that only applies after pressing Submit in a long form (a checkbox reads better there; **Planned**).
**Anatomy:** ① Track (44 × 24) · ② Thumb (16px) · ③ Label · ④ Description (optional) · ⑤ Focus ring.

| Figma property | Type | Values / default | Code prop | Type / default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Checked | Variant | False, True | `checked` / `defaultChecked`, `onChange` | `boolean`; `(checked) => void` |
| State | Variant | Default, Hover, Pressed, Focus, Disabled | `disabled`, `forceState` | `boolean`; `'hover' \| 'pressed' \| 'focus'` |
| Label | Text | "Label" | `label` | `ReactNode` (required) |
| Description | Text | "Description" | `description` | `ReactNode` |
| Show description | Boolean | false | `description` | omit to hide |
| none | | | `name`, `value`, `id` | native checkbox attributes |

| Layout | Token | Value |
|---|---|---|
| Track | `toggle/track-width` · `toggle/track-height` | 44 × 24px, radius full |
| Track border | `border-width/1-5` | 1.5px |
| Thumb · inset | `toggle/thumb-size` · `toggle/thumb-inset` | 16px · 4px (left when off, right when on) |
| Control→text gap | `space/12` | 12px |
| Focus ring | `toggle/focus-ring-width-size` × `toggle/focus-ring-height-size` | 52 × 32px, 2px, 2px gap |
| Text | Body (label), Small (description) | |

| State | Off: track bg / border / thumb | On: track bg / border / thumb |
|---|---|---|
| Default | `#FFFFFF` / `#8A6A4A` / `#8A6A4A` (4.95) | `#D8BFA0` / `#3B2A1E` / `#3B2A1E` (7.73) |
| Hover | `#F6EFE7` / `#6B4F35` / `#6B4F35` | `#CBAE8A` / `#3B2A1E` / `#3B2A1E` |
| Pressed | `#EADCCB` / `#6B4F35` / `#6B4F35` | `#BC9D76` / `#3B2A1E` / `#3B2A1E` |
| Focus | Default + focus ring | Default + focus ring |
| Disabled | `#EFE6DB` / `#DCCFBF` / `#9C8B7A`, text `#9C8B7A` (exempt) | same colours, thumb right |

Label `#3B2A1E` (13.67), description `#6B4F35` (7.51). The thumb slides in 120ms (no motion under reduced motion).

**Behaviour & accessibility:** a native `<input type="checkbox" role="switch">` inside a `<label>`, so the whole row is clickable, Space toggles it, and screen readers announce "switch, on/off". The description is linked with `aria-describedby`. On and off differ by **thumb position** (left → right) plus the filled sand track and darker border, never colour alone.

**Do / Don't**

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Label the setting as it reads when on: "Gift wrap this order". | A question or a double negative: "Gift wrap?", "Don't send emails". |
| Use when the change applies right away. | Use inside a form that only applies after Submit (use a checkbox; **Planned**). |
| Group related toggles under a legend: "Order preferences". | Scatter single toggles with no context. |
| Explain a disabled toggle: "Not available for pieces that ship by freight". | Disable it with no reason. |
| Let the knob position show the state. | Add "On/Off" text beside the switch, or icons inside the thumb. |

**Keyboard & screen reader**

| Key / event | Result |
|---|---|
| Tab | Focuses the switch (ring around the track) |
| Space | Toggles on/off (Enter does not; it's a checkbox underneath) |
| Click anywhere on the row | Toggles it |
| Announced | "Gift wrap this order, switch, on, Wrapped in recycled kraft paper and tied with jute twine" |

### 6.18 Product Row

[Figma 73:210](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=73-210) · [Storybook](https://chris-terterian.github.io/natural-design-system/?path=/story/components-product-row--all-variants)

**Purpose:** a titled row of products for home and collection pages ("New arrivals", "Made in clay"). **Anatomy:** ① Title (Heading/H3 style, `<h2>` in the outline) · ② View all link (Nav Link) · ③ Grid of Product Cards (exposed instances in Figma).

| Figma property | Type | Values / default | Code prop | Type / default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Breakpoint | Variant | Desktop, Mobile | automatic | container query at 768px |
| Title | Text | "New arrivals" | `title` | `string` (required) |
| Show view all | Boolean | true | `viewAllHref`, `viewAllLabel` | `string` (omit to hide) · `'View all'` |
| Cards (nested, exposed) | Product Card | 4 products | `products` | `ProductCardProps[]` (without `showCta`; the row decides) |

| Layout | Desktop | Mobile |
|---|---|---|
| Columns | 4 | 2 (same 4 products wrap to 2 rows) |
| Card size (at 1440 / 375) | 322 × 548.5, media 322 × 402.5 | 163.5 × ~350, media 163.5 × 204.4 |
| Gap (both directions) | 24px (`layout/gutter`) | 16px (`layout/gutter` (Mobile)) |
| Side margins | 40px (`layout/page-margin`) | 16px (`layout/page-margin` (Mobile)) |
| Top / bottom | 48px (`layout/section`) | 32px (`layout/section` (Mobile)) |
| Title → grid | 24px (`space/24`) | 24px |
| Title | Heading/H3, 24 / 32, `text/color/heading` `#3B2A1E` (13.67) | Heading/H3, 20 / 28 (Mobile mode) |
| Background | `bg/default` `#FFFFFF` | same |

**Buttons:** off by default. Most stores keep rows browsable and put Add to Bag on the product page, where size, finish and quantity are chosen; the whole card is still one link to it. Turn **Show buttons** on for quick-buy rows (restocks, small add-ons like cups). It applies to every card in the row, never card by card. In Figma it is a True/False variant rather than a boolean, because a row property can't reach inside the nested cards (D-022).

**Behaviour:** cards fill their column and each grid row stretches them to equal height, so with buttons on, the Add to Bag buttons line up even when a title wraps (mobile: "Basalt Mortar & Pestle" wraps to 2 lines). In Figma, the Show buttons = True card heights in a row are set to the tallest card with the Info block filling; update them if you change a product's text. With buttons off, cards hug their content.

**Do / Don't**

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| 4 products per row: a full row on desktop, 2 even rows on mobile. | 3 or 5 products, which leave gaps on one of the breakpoints. |
| Leave buttons off for browsing rows; turn them on for the whole row when quick-buy makes sense. | Mix cards with and without buttons in one row. |
| A short title in the product's language: "New arrivals", "Made in clay". | Marketing headlines: "Shop our amazing new collection!!". |
| Mix statuses honestly (Sale, Sold out) with correct badges. | Hide sold-out pieces or give every card a badge. |
| Keep 2 columns on phones. | Squeeze 3 or more cards across a phone screen (cards under ~160px lose the button and wrap titles badly). |

**Keyboard & screen reader**

| Key / event | Result |
|---|---|
| Tab order | View all → then each card (title link → Wishlist, plus Add to Bag / Notify me when Show buttons is on), left to right, top to bottom |
| Announced | A region labelled by its heading ("New arrivals, heading level 2"), then a list of 4 items, each a Product Card |

### 6.19 Heading & Text

[Figma 76:5 (Typography)](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=76-5) · [Storybook](https://chris-terterian.github.io/natural-design-system/?path=/story/foundations-typography--type-scale)

**Purpose:** the only way to set headers and paragraph copy, so content and category pages stay identical. In Figma, apply the **Heading/** and **Paragraph/** text styles; in code, use these two components.

| Code | Props | Figma equivalent |
|---|---|---|
| `<Heading level={1–6} size?>` | `level`: the HTML level (outline). `size`: `'h1' \| 'h2' \| 'h3' \| 'h4'`, defaults to the level (h5/h6 use H4) | Heading/H1 – H4 |
| `<Text variant? muted? as?>` | `variant`: `'paragraph-lg' \| 'paragraph' \| 'paragraph-sm' \| 'caption'` = `'paragraph'`. `muted`: secondary colour (default for small and caption). `as`: `p` (default), `span`, `div`, `figcaption` | Paragraph/Large · Default · Small, Caption |
| `className="nds-prose"` | Wrap a run of Headings and Text to get the vertical rhythm from §3.2 (paragraph spacing, space below/above headings) | Frame auto layout with `text/space/*` gaps |
| `data-nds-mode="desktop" \| "mobile"` | Forces a Typography mode for a subtree (docs, previews, fixed-width modules) | A frame's Typography mode |

```tsx
<article className="nds-prose">
  <Text variant="caption">Journal</Text>
  <Heading level={1}>Made from what the land lets go</Heading>
  <Text variant="paragraph-lg">Every piece starts with a material we didn't make…</Text>
  <Heading level={2}>Finding the wood</Heading>
  <Text>We only use trees that have already come down…</Text>
</article>
```

**Do / Don't**

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Use the same H1 + Paragraph/Large intro on every content and category page. | Style a category title differently from an article title. |
| One H1 per page; H2 and H3 for sections, in order. | Pick heading levels by size ("H4 looks right here"), or skip from H1 to H3 in the HTML. |
| Keep paragraphs at the 640px measure on desktop. | Let body copy run the full 1440px width. |
| Use Paragraph/Default for stories and descriptions. | Use Paragraph/Small or Caption for anything people need to read in full. |
| Let the mode change sizes. | Hand-set mobile sizes on individual text layers. |

**Keyboard & screen reader:** static text, not focusable. Headings form the page outline that screen reader users navigate by (H key / rotor), so the HTML levels must be in order.

### 6.20 Nav Dropdown & Nav Group

[Figma Nav Dropdown 83:510](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=83-510) · [Nav Group 83:97](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=83-97) · [Storybook](https://chris-terterian.github.io/natural-design-system/?path=/story/components-navigation-menu--nav-dropdowns)

**Purpose:** the panel a menu Nav Link opens on desktop, holding a section's categories. **Anatomy:** ① Panel (full width under the bar) · ② Nav Groups (group title + up to 4 Nav Links) · ③ View-all link on the right.

| Figma | Values | Code | Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| Nav Dropdown · Menu | Shop, Collections | `<NavDropdown groups viewAll id?>` | `NavGroupData[]`, `{ label, href }` |
| Nav Group · Title | Text | `<NavGroup title links>` | `string`, `{ label, href }[]` |
| Nav Group · Show link 4 | Boolean, true | `links.length` | 3 or 4 links per group |
| Groups / links (nested, exposed) | Nav Link instances | from `item.menu` in Navigation Menu | |

| Layout | Token | Value |
|---|---|---|
| Panel padding | `space/32` · `layout/page-margin` | 32 · 40px |
| Between groups | `space/48` | 48px |
| Group title → links | `space/8` | 8px |
| Group title | `ui/label/font-size` · `ui/label/line-height`, 600, `fg/muted` | 14 / 20, `#6B4F35` (7.51:1) |
| Links | Nav Link Default | 16 / 24, `#3B2A1E` (13.67:1) |
| Background · border | `bg/default` · `border/muted` | `#FFFFFF` · 1px `#E3D8CB` bottom (decorative) |

**Content (from the store's catalogue):**

| Menu | Groups | View all |
|---|---|---|
| Shop | Furniture (Benches, Stools, Side tables, Shelves) · Kitchen & table (Cups & mugs, Bowls, Boards & trays, Utensils) · Home & living (Baskets, Vessels, Candle holders, Throws) | Shop all |
| Collections | By material (Clay & ceramics, Wood, Stone, Fibre & rush) · Edits (One of a kind, Made to order, Gifts under $50) | All collections |

**Behaviour & accessibility:** disclosure pattern, not an ARIA menu. The panel is a plain region of links (`id` referenced by the button's `aria-controls`); group titles label their lists (`aria-labelledby`), so they aren't headings and don't clutter the page outline. It shows only at the desktop breakpoint; on mobile the same data drives the Mobile Menu submenu.

**Do / Don't**

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| 2–4 groups, 3–4 links each, named by what people shop for. | Walls of 10+ links, or internal jargon. |
| Always include a view-all link. | Make the section's landing page reachable only from a group. |
| Keep it text-only and flat, like the rest of the UI. | Add shadows, animation, or promotional banners that push links down. |

**Keyboard & screen reader:** Tab moves from the open button into the panel's links in order; Escape closes and returns focus to the button. Announced as "Furniture, list, 4 items: Benches, link…".

### 6.21 Date Field

[Figma 1:498](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=1-498) (Type=Date) · [Storybook](https://chris-terterian.github.io/natural-design-system/?path=/story/components-input--date)

**Purpose:** one date in a form: delivery day, workshop booking, pickup. **Anatomy:** ① Label · ② Field: typed value (MM/DD/YYYY) + status icon + ③ Calendar button (24px, Icon/Calendar) · ④ Helper · ⑤ Calendar popover (Calendar, Mode=Single), 4px below the field (`space/4`).

Same properties, states and colours as Text Field (§6.4), plus:

| Figma | Code prop | Type / default |
|---|---|---|
| Type=Date | `DateField` | |
| Value "MM/DD/YYYY" (placeholder) · "10/09/2026" (filled) | `value` / `defaultValue`, `onChange` | `Date \| null`; `onChange(date \| null)` fires on a pick, or when typed text parses on blur / Enter |
| Calendar rules (example: earliest Oct 5, no Sundays) | `min`, `max`, `isDateDisabled`, `today`, `locale` | passed to the Calendar |
| Example / Open | `defaultOpen` | `false` (docs and tests) |
| Read-only hides the Calendar button | `readOnly` | |

| Part | Tokens |
|---|---|
| Calendar button | `size/target-min` (24, the WCAG 2.2 minimum target) · `radius/8` · hover `control/bg-hover` · pressed `control/bg-pressed` · icon `fg/muted`, disabled `fg/disabled` · focus ring as the field |
| Popover | `space/4` (4px); the Calendar keeps its own border and radius |

**Behaviour:** the field accepts typing so keyboard and screen-reader users never depend on the grid. Validation stays with the form (e.g. Error "We don’t deliver on Sundays."); the Calendar only prevents picking unavailable days. With nothing chosen, the Calendar opens on the first month with an available day and focuses the first one.

**Do / Don't**

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Explain availability in the helper: "Earliest delivery Oct 5. No Sundays." | Leave people guessing why days are struck through. |
| Keep typing possible; show the format as the placeholder. | Make the field read-only just to force the calendar. |
| Confirm a good pick in the Success message: "Arrives Friday, October 9." | Repeat the date back as a bare number. |

**Keyboard & screen reader**

| Key / event | Result |
|---|---|
| Tab | Field, then the Calendar button |
| Enter (in the field) | Parses the typed date |
| Enter / Space (button) | Opens the Calendar; focus moves to the selected day (or the first available one) |
| In the Calendar | Arrow keys, Home / End, Page Up / Down as §6.22; Enter picks, closes and returns focus to the button |
| Escape | Closes without choosing; focus returns to the button |
| Announced | Label, "edit text", helper; button "Choose date, Friday, October 9, 2026, collapsed / expanded"; popover "Delivery date, choose a date, dialog" |

### 6.22 Calendar & Calendar Day

[Figma 196:580](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=196-580) (Calendar) · [Figma 195:65](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=195-65) (Calendar Day) · [Storybook](https://chris-terterian.github.io/natural-design-system/?path=/docs/components-calendar--docs)

**Status: Beta.** **Purpose:** choose a date (Mode=Single) or a date range (Mode=Range): delivery dates, workshop bookings, pickup windows. **Anatomy:** ① Header: Previous month and Next month (Icon Buttons) around the month title · ② Weekday row (Mo–Su) · ③ 6 weeks of Calendar Days, Monday first, so the height never jumps between months.

| Figma property | Type | Values / default | Code prop | Type / default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mode | Variant | **Single**, Range | `mode` | `'single'` · `'range'` |
| Month | Text | "October 2026" | `month` / `defaultMonth`, `onMonthChange` | `Date`; defaults to the selection, today, or the earliest allowed month |
| Days (nested, exposed) | Calendar Day | 42 | `selected` / `defaultSelected`, `onSelect` | `Date \| null` (single) · `{ start, end }` (range) |
| none | | | `min`, `max`, `isDateDisabled` | unavailable days |
| none | | | `today`, `weekStartsOn`, `locale`, `autoFocus`, `label` | `new Date()` · `1` (Monday) · `'en-US'` · `false` · required accessible name |

**Calendar Day** (Figma 195:65; `CalendarDay` in code): State = Default, Hover, Pressed, Focus, Selected, Range start, Range middle, Range end, Outside, Disabled; Day (text); Today (boolean, the dot).

| State | Look | Tokens | Contrast |
|---|---|---|---|
| Default | number on white | `fg/default` | 13.67:1 |
| Hover / Pressed | circle fill | `control/bg-hover` · `/pressed` | text 12+:1 |
| Focus | 2px ring, 2px gap | `focus/ring`, `-width`, `-offset` | 13.67:1 |
| Selected, Range start / end | ink circle, white Semi Bold number | `bg/emphasis`, `fg/on-emphasis` | 13.67:1 |
| Range middle | band with a dark top and bottom edge | `bg/muted`, `border/default` | edge 4.95:1, text 12+:1 |
| Outside | another month's day | `fg/subtle` | 4.95:1 |
| Disabled | struck through | `fg/disabled` | exempt; strikethrough so not colour alone |
| Today | 4px dot under the number | `fg/default`, `-size`, `-offset` | same as the text |

Sizes: day `calendar/day/size` 40 (circle, `radius/full`) · padding 16 · gap 12 (header, weekdays, weeks) · row gap 4 · width 312. Container `bg/default`, `border/muted`, `radius/12` 12. Title 16/24 Semi Bold; weekdays 12/16 `fg/muted` (7.51:1); days 14/20.

**Behaviour:** in Range, the first click sets the start and the second the end (either order); a third click starts again. Disabled days stay focusable (`aria-disabled`) so arrow keys can move past them, but can't be chosen. Outside days can be chosen and switch the month.

**Beta gaps:** no preview of a range while hovering before the second click; a range can span disabled days; one month at a time.

**Do / Don't**

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Disable days that can't be delivered and say why nearby. | Hide unavailable days or let people pick them and fail at checkout. |
| Use Range for windows (pickup, hire). | Use two Single calendars for a start and end. |
| Put it in a Date Field for forms. | Show a bare calendar where typing a date would be faster. |

**Keyboard & screen reader**

| Key | Result |
|---|---|
| Tab | Previous month → Next month → the grid (one tab stop: the selected or first available day) |
| ← → ↑ ↓ | Previous / next day, previous / next week; crossing the month edge turns the page |
| Home / End | First / last day of the week |
| Page Up / Page Down | Previous / next month (Shift: year) |
| Enter / Space | Choose the day |
| Announced | Group "Delivery date"; grid "October 2026" (month changes announced politely); each day by full date, e.g. "Friday, October 9, 2026, selected"; today as "current date"; weekday headers by full name |

### 6.23 Image Block

[Figma 212:29](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=212-29) · [Storybook](https://chris-terterian.github.io/natural-design-system/?path=/docs/components-image-block--docs)

**Status: Beta.** **Purpose:** full-bleed site imagery: a hero at the top of a page, a banner between sections, a half-page image beside copy. **Anatomy:** ① Media (photo, cropped to cover) · ② Placeholder glyph until a photo is added · ③ Copy (Half-page only, in code: `children`).

| Figma property | Type | Values / default | Code prop | Type / default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Type | Variant | **Hero**, Banner, Half-page | `type` | `'hero'` · `'banner'` · `'half'` |
| Breakpoint | Variant | Desktop, Mobile | automatic | container query at 768px |
| Show placeholder | Boolean | true | no `src` | the placeholder shows until `src` is set |
| Photo (fill of the instance) | Image fill | | `src`, `alt` (required) | `alt=""` marks it decorative |

| Type | Desktop | Mobile | Tokens |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hero | 1440 × 640, full width | 375 × 480 (4:5) | `image/hero/height`, `image/hero/height` (Mobile) |
| Banner | 1440 × 360 (4:1), full width | 375 × 200 | `image/banner/height`, `image/banner/height` (Mobile) |
| Half-page | 720 × 720: half the row, square, copy beside it | 375 × 375: full width, copy below | `image/half/size`, `image/half/size` (Mobile) |

Placeholder: `bg/muted` with the `fg/decorative` glyph. Half-page copy uses `layout/section`, `layout/page-margin` and `text/space/after-heading`, so it lines up with Product Rows. Heroes load eagerly; the rest lazy-load.

**Beta gaps:** placeholder only until real photography exists; no art direction (a different crop per breakpoint with `<picture>`); no text-over-image hero.

**Do / Don't**

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Show the material and the making: split oak, wet clay, a hand on a wheel. | Stock lifestyle shots with no product in them. |
| Keep the subject centred; mobile crops the sides. | Put the product at the edge of a hero, where mobile cuts it off. |
| Alt text names the material first: "Split oak bench on a stone floor". | "Hero image", "banner", or a file name. |
| Pair a Half-page image with one short heading, a paragraph and one action. | Put text on top of photos (contrast can't be guaranteed). |

**Keyboard & screen reader:** not focusable. A photo is announced by its alt text ("Split oak bench on a stone floor, image"); `alt=""` hides a decorative one. The Half-page copy follows in reading order.
