[Figma 221:136](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=221-136) (Footer) · [Figma 223:116](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=223-116) (Footer Column) · [Figma 221:16](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=221-16) (Footer Link) · [Storybook](https://chris-terterian.github.io/natural-design-system/?path=/docs/components-footer--docs)

**Status: Beta.** **Purpose:** the site footer on every page. **Anatomy:** ① Three Footer Columns (Shop, About, Help), each a heading and up to five Footer Links · ② Divider · ③ Logo + copyright · ④ Legal links (Privacy policy, Terms of service, Accessibility).

| Figma property | Type | Values / default | Code prop | Type / default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Footer · Breakpoint | Variant | Desktop, Mobile | automatic | container query at 768px |
| Footer · Copyright | Text | "© 2026 Natural. All rights reserved." | `copyright` | `string`; defaults to the current year |
| Footer · columns (nested, exposed) | Footer Column | Shop, About, Help | `columns` | `FooterColumnProps[]` (`DEFAULT_FOOTER_COLUMNS`) |
| Footer · legal links | Footer Link (Small) | 3 | `legalLinks` | `FooterLinkItem[]` (`DEFAULT_LEGAL_LINKS`) |
| Footer Column · Mode | Variant | **Static** (desktop), Collapsed, Expanded (mobile) | automatic; `defaultOpen` | `false` |
| Footer Column · Title, Show link 5 | Text, Boolean | "Shop", true | `title`, `links` | |
| Footer Link · Size | Variant | **Default** (14/20), Small (12/16) | `size` | `'default'` · `'small'` |
| Footer Link · State | Variant | Default, Hover, Focus | `forceState` | docs only |

| | Desktop (1440) | Mobile (375) |
|---|---|---|
| Columns | side by side, 4 of 12 each, 24 gap | stacked **disclosures**: 44px buttons (20 + 12 + 12) with a chevron, divider below, closed by default |
| Padding | 48 top, 40 sides, 32 bottom | 32 top, 16 sides, 32 bottom |
| Columns → bottom row | 48 | 32 |
| Bottom row | Logo + copyright left, legal links right | stacked: Logo, copyright, legal links |
| Height | 368 | 356 closed · 520 with one section open |

Colours: `bg/subtle` sand (brown/50), `border/muted` dividers. Titles and hover 11.99:1, links and copyright 6.59:1, focus ring 11.99:1. Hover adds an underline, so it never relies on colour alone. Every link is at least 24px tall (links 20 + 2 + 2, legal 16 + 4 + 4). Dividers take no space (Figma strokes outside layout, inset shadows in code), so the two match to the pixel.

**Beta gaps:** no newsletter sign-up or social links yet; three columns in Figma (code takes any number).

**Do / Don't**

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Group links by what people come for: Shop, About, Help. | One long list, or columns named "Links" and "More". |
| Keep sections collapsed on mobile so the footer stays short. | Stack every link on a phone; people scroll past it. |
| Link text says where it goes: "Returns & exchanges". | "Click here", "Learn more". |

**Keyboard & screen reader**

| Key / event | Result |
|---|---|
| Tab (desktop) | Each column's links in order, then the Logo, then the legal links |
| Tab (mobile) | Shop, About, Help buttons; an open section's links follow its button; closed sections' links are skipped |
| Enter / Space (mobile button) | Opens or closes that section; the chevron flips |
| Announced | "contentinfo" landmark; each column a navigation named by its title ("Shop, navigation"); mobile buttons "Shop, button, collapsed / expanded" inside a heading; legal links in a "Legal" navigation |

### 6.25 Slider, Slider Thumb & Slider Input

[Figma 239:2732](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=239-2732) (Slider) · [Figma 239:655](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=239-655) (Slider Thumb) · [Figma 239:665](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=239-665) (Slider Input) · [Storybook](https://chris-terterian.github.io/natural-design-system/?path=/docs/components-slider--docs)

**Status: Beta.** **Purpose:** choose one value in a range: max price in a filter, bench length, number of place settings. **Anatomy:** ① Label · ② Track: sand rail + ink filled part · ③ Slider Thumb · ④ optional Slider Input (number field).

| Figma property | Type | Values / default | Code prop | Type / default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Field | Variant | **None**, Start, End, Top, Bottom | `field` | `'none'` · `'start'` · `'end'` · `'top'` · `'bottom'` |
| State | Variant | Default, Disabled | `disabled` | `false` |
| Label / Show label | Text / Boolean | "Max price ($)" / true | `label` (required) / `hideLabel` | hidden labels stay for screen readers |
| Slider Thumb · State | Variant (nested) | Default, Hover, Pressed, Focus, Disabled | `forceState` | docs only |
| Slider Input · Value, State | Text, Variant (nested) | "240"; Default, Hover, Focus, Disabled | `value` / `defaultValue`, `fieldForceState` | `number` |
| none | | | `min`, `max`, `step`, `onChange`, `formatValue` | `0`, `100`, `1`; `formatValue` sets `aria-valuetext` ("$240") |

| Part | Size | Tokens |
|---|---|---|
| Slider | 320 wide; 72 tall (label + 44 hit area); 124 with the field above or below | `size/field`, `space/8` 8 |
| Track | 4 tall, full radius, in a 44px hit area | `slider/track-height`, `size/control`, `accent/bg` (sand), `bg/emphasis` (ink) |
| Thumb | 20 circle, white, 2px ink ring | `slider/thumb-size`, `bg/default`, `border/strong`, hover `bg-hover`, pressed `bg-pressed` |
| Field | 72 × 44, 12 side padding, radius 8 | `slider/field-width` (72), `size/control` (44), `space/12`, `radius/8`, `border/*`; beside the track: `space/16` 16 |
| Focus | 2px ring, 2px gap (around the thumb) | `focus/ring`, `-width`, `-offset` |

**Accessibility:** the thumb's position carries the value (ink ring 13.67:1), the filled track is ink, and the field or `aria-valuetext` states the number, so the sand rail (range only) doesn't need 3:1. Native range input, so keyboard and screen readers work everywhere. The field is labelled "Max price ($), exact value"; typed values commit on blur or Enter, snapped to the step and clamped to min and max.

**Beta gaps:** no tick marks or min / max captions. For a from–to range, use Range Slider (§6.26).

**Do / Don't**

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Add the field when exact values matter (price, length in cm). | Make people drag to hit $237. |
| Use a step that matches the product: $10 for price, 5 cm for length. | Step by 1 over a 0–600 range. |
| Say the unit in the label: "Max price ($)", "Length (cm)". | Leave the number unitless. |

**Keyboard & screen reader**

| Key | Result |
|---|---|
| ← ↓ / → ↑ | One step down / up |
| Page Down / Page Up | Ten steps |
| Home / End | Minimum / maximum |
| Tab | Moves between the slider and its field (in visual order) |
| Announced | "Max price ($), slider, $240"; field "Max price ($), exact value, spin button, 240" |

### 6.26 Range Slider

[Figma 242:722](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=242-722) · [Storybook](https://chris-terterian.github.io/natural-design-system/?path=/story/components-slider--range)

**Status: Beta.** **Purpose:** choose a from–to range: price in a collection filter, a length span. Two Slider Thumbs on one track, ink fill **between** them. Same thumb, field, sizes and colours as Slider (§6.25).

| Figma property | Type | Values / default | Code prop | Type / default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Field | Variant | **None**, Sides (min field at the start, max at the end), Top, Bottom ("120 to 360" row) | `field` | `'none'` · `'sides'` · `'top'` · `'bottom'` |
| State | Variant | Default, Disabled | `disabled` | `false` |
| Label / Show label | Text / Boolean | "Price ($)" / true | `label` / `hideLabel` | group name |
| none | | | `value` / `defaultValue`, `onChange` | `[number, number]` |
| none | | | `min`, `max`, `step`, `minGap`, `formatValue` | `minGap` defaults to one step |

**Behaviour:** the thumbs never cross (at least `minGap` apart). Typed values are snapped and clamped the same way. Where the thumbs overlap, the one that can still move is on top: the maximum, unless it's already at the top of the range. "to" between the fields is `separator` text (`fg/muted`), hidden from screen readers.

**Accessibility:** a group named by the label ("Price ($)"), containing two native range inputs, "Price ($), minimum" and "Price ($), maximum", each with the full browser keyboard (arrows, Page Up / Down, Home / End) and `aria-valuetext`. Fields are "Price ($), minimum, exact value" and "…maximum, exact value". Tab order: min field, min thumb, max thumb, max field (Sides), or thumbs then fields.

**Do / Don't**

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Use for filters where both ends matter: "$120 to $360". | Use two single Sliders for min and max. |
| Show the fields when exact bounds matter. | Hide the numbers so people guess from thumb positions. |

### 6.27 Text Button

[Figma 245:658](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=245-658) · [Storybook](https://chris-terterian.github.io/natural-design-system/?path=/docs/components-text-button--docs)

**Status: Beta.** **Purpose:** small secondary actions that shouldn't compete with the main button: Remove, Edit, Save for later. A real `<button>` that looks like underlined text (use a link, not this, for navigation).

| Figma property | Type | Values / default | Code prop | Type / default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Label | Text | "Remove" | `children` | give context with `aria-label` when the label alone is ambiguous |
| State | Variant | Default, Hover, Focus, Disabled | `forceState`, `disabled` | docs only / native |

14/20, `fg/default` ink (13.67:1), hover `fg/muted` (7.51:1), underlined in every state, 24px tall (20 + 2 + 2), focus ring 2px with a 2px gap.

**Keyboard & screen reader:** Tab to focus; Enter or Space activates. Announced as "Remove Split Log Bench, button" when given context.

**Do / Don't**

[Figma 248:77](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=248-77) · [Storybook](https://chris-terterian.github.io/natural-design-system/?path=/docs/components-cart-drawer--docs) · Example: [Desktop category page](https://www.figma.com/design/84MjZXozBoKCvf9lwIU5pu/Natural-Design-System?node-id=249-2) (prototype: click Bag)

**Status: Beta.** **Purpose:** the bag as a sidebar, opened from the header's Bag Icon Button, so people can check the bag without leaving the page. **Anatomy:** ① Header: "Your bag (3)" + Close (Icon Button) · ② Cart Lines (scroll) · ③ Summary: Subtotal, note, Check out (Button, full width), Continue shopping (Text Button).

## 8. Accessibility standard (WCAG 2.2 AA)

Non-negotiable for every component and page. Each component in §6 lists its own keyboard and screen reader behaviour; this section is the standard they all meet.

### 8.1 Perceivable

- **Contrast:** text ≥ 4.5:1; large text (24px+) ≥ 3:1; UI boundaries, icons and focus rings ≥ 3:1. Measured pairs are in §3.1. Disabled controls are exempt and intentionally faded.
- **Never colour alone:**

  | State | Shown by |
  |---|---|
  | Errors | Icon + message |
  | Sale | Badge + strikethrough |
  | Current page | Indicator + heavier weight |
  | Wishlist | Filled vs outline shape |
  | Toggle | Knob position (left / right) + filled track |

- **Text alternatives:** every product image has material-first alt text (§2); decorative images and icons are hidden (`alt=""`, `aria-hidden`).
- **Resize & reflow:** usable at 200% zoom and at 320px wide with no horizontal scrolling (except large data tables). The header switches to its mobile layout by container width, which helps here.
- **Text spacing:** nothing breaks when users increase line height to 1.5, paragraph spacing to 2×, and letter spacing to 0.12em. Never fix text container heights.

### 8.2 Operable

- **Keyboard:** everything works with a keyboard alone: Tab / Shift+Tab to move, Enter for links and buttons, Space for buttons, toggles and radios, arrows inside radio groups, Escape to close dialogs.
- **Focus visible:** the Focus ring (§4.3) on every focusable element, never removed; focused items are never hidden behind sticky headers or overlays.
- **Focus order:** follows reading order: header → main content → footer. Modals move focus in, trap it, and return it on close (Mobile Menu).
- **Targets:** 44px minimum for controls, so neighbours can sit close (the header icons are 4px apart). Never go below 24px (WCAG 2.5.8); anything smaller than 44px needs clear space so its 24px target circle doesn't overlap another.
- **Motion:** respect `prefers-reduced-motion` (image zoom off, spinner slowed, toggle slide off). Nothing flashes more than 3 times a second; no auto-playing carousels.
- **No keyboard traps** outside modals, and **no time limits** on checkout without a way to extend.

### 8.3 Understandable

- **Language:** set `lang="en"` on the page.
- **Consistent:** the same components, labels and order everywhere (e.g. "Add to Bag" never becomes "Add to Cart" elsewhere).
- **Forms:** visible labels; instructions before the field; errors after leaving the field or on submit, in text, with how to fix; on submit, focus moves to the first error. Use `autocomplete` for personal data (name, email, address, card).
- **No surprises:** changing a radio or toggle never navigates or submits on its own.

### 8.4 Robust

- **Native first:** `<button>`, `<a>`, `<input>`, `<fieldset>`/`<legend>`, `<dialog>` before any ARIA.
- **ARIA only to add state:** `aria-pressed` (Wishlist), `aria-current` (nav), `aria-expanded` + `aria-haspopup` (Menu), `aria-busy` (Loading), `aria-invalid` + `aria-describedby` (fields), `role="switch"` (Toggle).
- **Names include context:** "Add River Clay Cup to wishlist", "Bag, 2 items", "Natural — home".
- **Landmarks:** one `<header>`, `<nav aria-label="Main">`, one `<main>`, one `<footer>`.

### 8.5 Before shipping (checklist)

- [ ] Storybook Accessibility panel (axe) shows no violations on every story
- [ ] Keyboard only: reach and operate everything; the focus ring is always visible; the order makes sense
- [ ] Screen reader pass (VoiceOver on macOS/iOS or NVDA on Windows): names, roles, states and errors are announced as §6 describes
- [ ] 200% zoom and a 320px-wide viewport: nothing clipped, overlapping or scrolling sideways
- [ ] Reduced motion on: no zoom, no slide
- [ ] Every new colour pair measured and added to §3.1

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| `<button aria-label="Bag, 2 items">` | `<div onclick>` with an icon and no name |
| Error: icon + "Enter a valid email address." under the field | Only turning the border red |
| Keep the focus ring and style it (§4.3) | `outline: none` with no replacement |
| Alt: "Split log bench in oak, seen from the side on a stone floor" | Alt: "image1.jpg" or "Beautiful bench" |

## 9. Workflow

**The repo is the source of truth.** Figma mirrors it; Storybook shows it.

1. Change tokens or components in code (or design in Figma, then mirror to code).
2. Check it in Storybook (`npm run storybook` → http://localhost:6007): All Variants story plus the axe panel.
3. Update Figma: sync variables (§5) and apply component changes, then screenshot to verify.
4. Confirm Figma and code match: same component names, variants, properties and token values. Update §6 of this file.
5. **Ask before committing and pushing** to `main`. A push runs the quality gates (typecheck, governance, build, accessibility) and deploys Storybook to GitHub Pages only if all pass. Change tiers, lifecycle and release steps: `GOVERNANCE.md`.

**Building with AI agents** (D-031). The Natural MCP server (`npm run mcp`, see `mcp/README.md`) gives agents the components, specs, tokens and brand rules, plus the repo's own checks. Agents work in small steps with a checkpoint after each (0 anchor, 1 plan, 2 structure, 3 style, 4 content, 5 accessibility) and finish with `run_checkpoints`, which re-runs them in order and stops at the first failure. A pass means ready for human review, never merged by the agent.

**Adding a component checklist**
- [ ] Figma: component set with labelled grid (State columns, variant rows), every fill, stroke, size and type bound to variables, contrast noted.
- [ ] Reuse, don't rebuild: nest existing components (Button, Badge, Icon Button…) as exposed instances.
- [ ] Tokens: roles from Color / Dimension / Layout / Typography and the public scale; a Component token only for a one-off decision (§5), mirrored in `tokens/figma-variables.json`.
- [ ] Code: `src/components/<Name>/` with `.tsx`, `.css` (tokens only) and `.stories.tsx` (Figma link + All Variants).
- [ ] Export from `src/index.ts`; add a full spec to §6 (same template) and a row to the README table.
- [ ] Registry entry in `governance/components.json` (status **Beta** with known gaps) and a `CHANGELOG.md` entry.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes (typecheck, governance, build, accessibility); Figma and JSON match.
